painpoints.text: scripts/qualitygate.nu routes root-manifest/lock diffs to cargo-check-only (line ~68 'root manifest/lock changed -> workspace-wide gate (cargo check)'), which is exactly the wrong scope for upstream merges — the merge procedure demands near-full fmt+clippy+nextest and I had to run both manually. Fix idea: treat a merge commit (two-parent HEAD) or an env flag like FABRO_GATE_SCOPE=merge as full workspace clippy+nextest.

Interrupting a long `cargo nextest run` (my first full-suite run hit the tool timeout at ~10min) leaves the shared CLI test fixture corrupt: /tmp/fx/n-*/storage/db/fabro.sqlite3 keeps a stale WAL + defunct fabro daemons, and the NEXT run fails with 'environment seed thread should not panic' (fabro-test/src/lib.rs:698) — looks like a real regression. Fix idea: fabro-test should clear/recover a stale fixture dir on seed failure, or the merge procedure should document `rm -rf /tmp/fx` after any interrupted run.

Three agent_run_* tests in lib/components/fabro-workflow/src/handler/llm/api.rs were red at PRE-MERGE HEAD (duplicate-child guard commit landed without updating MockRunToolBackend::list_store_runs_by_parent) — proving pre-existence cost a full worktree rebuild (~6min). Recurrence of the 2026-09-06 'compile-only gate debt' class: seeds-sync/engine commits are landing without nextest. Fix idea: engine checkpoint commits should run at least nextest on crates whose tests reference the touched seed.

observations: 25 upstream commits (2f326a13c..290e0d7e6), newest subject 'Bump version to 0.353.0-nightly.0'; the lithos-llm migration dominated — fabro-llm rebuilt on lithos, fabro-model deleted, lithos types through API/server/CLI/web.

17 conflicted files: mostly import-block unions (take upstream, re-add fork-only names) plus two modify/delete classes — fabro-model and fabro-llm/generate.rs; conflict-policy covered every class, no manual escalation needed.

Fork glm catalog fixes (zai glm-5.3 default, glm-4.7 always-reasoning, alias moves) now live in lib/components/fabro-llm/src/fork-catalog-overlay.toml layered in fabro_llm::build_catalog between lithos builtins and the operator [llm] overlay — the next merger must look THERE, fabro-model no longer exists.

Gate duration ~6.5h total: workspace clippy ~1min/run, full nextest 2-6min/run under load; final state 7783/7787 with 4 triaged residuals (spa_refresh uid-0 permission trick, merged_wait red at pre-merge HEAD, two 6s-budget workflow tests that pass in isolation but flake under full-suite parallel load).

SSE fixtures needed lithos-codec conformance: chat-completions streams must carry finish_reason:stop (no synthesis from [DONE] alone), responses-codec terminal events need status+output array; mock paths are now /v1/chat/completions.
